title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming Euroleague Basketball game between Partizan and Valencia, originally scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 2:45 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):

This market will resolve to "Over" if Partizan and Valencia combine to score 175 or more points in this game.

If the combined total is less than 175, this market will resolve to "Under".

If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Thursday, November 19, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.

The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods. This market will resolve according to the official final score published on euroleaguebasketball.net.
